translated_title: Historic 'Huachicol' Seizure in Guanajuato, Thanks to Setting Aside Political Differences and Tightening Coordination, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Decomiso histórico de 'huachicol' en Guanajuato, por dejar las diferencias políticas y estrechar coordinación: Sheinbaum
author: Alonso Urrutia
meta_description: More than 50 million liters of stolen fuel were seized as Guanajuato's daily homicides fell from over 12 to about four, a 75% drop.
